name: text-weight-pulse
title: Variable Font Pulse
description: Nét chữ phình từ mảnh sang đậm rồi về mảnh, khoảng cách chữ co lại bù trừ để cả từ không đổi bề rộng.

moworks.author: moworks

options.tight: em of tracking at the peak (0.02)
options.keepWidth: loosen the tracking as the strokes thin, so the word keeps its width

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: One word (40 px). wght 200 → 900 over 0.3–1.5 s, hold to 2.3 s, 900 → 200 over 2.3–3.5 s, hold to 4.2 s (loop); ease cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1). Tracking moves the other way, 8 px → 0.8 px (0.2 → 0.02 em), so the word width stays constant (the demo fakes weight with a 0–6 px stroke on a 200 face: tracking = 8 − 1.2 × stroke). Params: from, to: độ đậm (200 → 900) · duration: mỗi chiều (1.2 s) · hold: giữ ở đỉnh (0.8 s) · keepWidth: bù giãn chữ để giữ bề rộng (bật). Needs a variable font with a wght axis. The word's width is measured at nine weights first, and the tracking at each frame makes up the difference.
moworks.titleVi: Nét chữ phình xẹp, giữ nguyên bề rộng
